text:
anya: quick poll  working on Usage & Billing layout for orgs: persistent left rail (filters + token breakdown) or stacked cards across the page? thoughts?
carlos: left rail for desktop. keeps charts centered and lets users pin scope while scrolling.
mira: stacked cards win on smaller widths. they collapse into a simple vertical flow and feel less cramped.
owen: accessibility callout  if we use a left rail we need a visible skip link and clear tab order. also aria-region label.
carlos: +1. and make sure the rail can be toggled via keyboard (Ctrl+M?) and has an obvious focus state.
anya: microcopy note: current label "Scope" is ambiguous. propose "Account | Project" tabs so it's explicit.
mira: agree, explicit tabs reduce confusion. default to Account for org admins, remember last-used scope for others.
owen: color concern: token legend colors fail contrast at small sizes. consider solid borders or pattern overlays.
carlos: pattern + color is smart. also include a legend toggle to show labels for colorblind mode.
anya: download CTA: many customers expect PDF. primary "Download invoice" should open small menu: PDF / CSV / Line items.
mira: track which export is chosen so we can surface the most-used default later.
owen: invoice modal accessibility: trap focus, heading e.g. "Invoice 04-2026  Redwood Inference", and keyboard order formats -> download -> close.
design-bot: Figma frames uploaded  https://figma.com/file/abc789  contains rail + stacked + mobile accordion states and notes for ARIA.
carlos: animation nit: collapse/expand should be fast (150-200ms) and respect reduced-motion.
anya: action items: owen  audit focus order + skip link; carlos  prototype rail toggle + reduced-motion; mira  mock stacked card collapse affordance + copy. 20m touch tomorrow after prototypes?
owen: on it, will post ARIA snippets.
carlos: prototyping today.
mira: will share mobile flows by EOD.
anya: thanks all  will follow up with the Figma link and meeting invite. :calendar:
